reviews.text: I traveled to Milan with my dog, and she ate something that made her sick. I took her to this vet as an emergency because it was the closest to our accommodation. They treated us very well; the doctor made a good diagnosis and prescribed the right medication. I highly recommend them.

We were very well looked after by Dr. Francesca Di Ciommo, who was attentive and caring with my dog. Even after we had left the city, she held a proper remote consultation while he was recovering. Rare dedication. Highly recommend!

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Dott.ssa Francesca and her entire team. They were the ones who discovered Rufus’s cancer, and from the very beginning, they treated him with such incredible care, compassion, and attention.

Going through something like this with your dog is scary, but I always felt like Rufus was in the best possible hands. The team took the time to explain everything clearly, answer my questions, and make sure we understood every step of his treatment. More importantly, you could genuinely feel how much everyone cared cared about him.

I’m so grateful to them for finding & treating his cancer, taking such good care of him, and supporting us through such a difficult time. Rufus could not have had a kinder or more dedicated team looking after him. I would recommend them wholeheartedly to anyone looking for a veterinarian they can truly trust 🖤🐾

We can only recommend this clinic and its entire team.

From the very first moment, we were greeted with great professionalism, helpfulness, and compassion. At a particularly delicate time for us, they listened carefully, explained each step clearly, and helped us find the best solution for little Odie, always respecting procedures and with great expertise.

What struck us most was the love and dedication they put into their work. They didn't just do their job: they made us feel understood and supported throughout the entire process.

Thanks to their help, Odie was able to start a new life with our family in Portugal. We will always be grateful for the kindness, sensitivity, and professionalism they showed us.

Thank you so much to the entire team. Keep up the good work, because people like you truly make a difference!

P.S. During the visit, we spent more time choosing a name than deciding anything else! In the end, we chose Odie, inspired by the Odyssey: for such a small kitten, she's already experienced a journey worthy of Ulysses. Luckily, along the way, she's also met people like you, whose professionalism and humanity have made her journey home much easier. 💜🐾

MyVet is the fourth veterinary clinic to care for my dogs in Milan, and it's undoubtedly the best. They are true professionals: competent, meticulous, and always attentive to the needs of pets and their owners. The clinic has specialists in various fields, offering the best possible care for our four-legged friends. It will undoubtedly be our go-to veterinary clinic. I highly recommend it!

We spayed our poodle after her first heat and within the recommended timeframe. Dr. Di Ciommo was, as always, helpful and clear in explaining everything to me, making me feel at ease throughout the process. My dog ​​is only 10 months old, and the surgery went very well, with a quick recovery and lots of attention, even post-op. You can see how much she loves animals and cares about their well-being. I highly recommend her ♥️

The doctors (except the director) who have treated us for various checkups, including specialist ones, are truly kind and professional. They try to explain things simply and understandably and write the reports carefully.

BUT... Dr. Francesca, who is the director, just doesn't know how to handle animals: she doesn't put her heart into it and doesn't put the animal's health first, but instead focuses only on BILLING, continuing to SELL countless checkups, tests, specialist visits, and products. During one visit, another doctor present with her didn't agree with doing all those tests. When she did the visit alone, she never writes a detailed report, and if you then ask her for clarification on WhatsApp, it almost seems like she's asking for a favor, and she sends you a report that contains almost nothing clear.
Well... they're also kind, but it seems to me that there's a tendency to "sell" exams... and despite how much I spent, I didn't get anything done... I won't go back there.

I had an excellent experience at this veterinary clinic in Milan. From the first contact, the service was extremely professional, welcoming, and organized. The team demonstrates not only a high level of technical expertise but also genuine sensitivity and care for the animals and their owners.
Professionalism and kindness. Excellent experience.

About a month ago, I brought my Rey to this clinic after visiting several clinics that never managed to get him well, and I would truly like to thank the MyVet team for literally saving him. Doctors Francesca, Marta, Maria, and Eliana did the impossible, managing to get Rey back on track, even though we thought he was beyond treatment. Like almost all shepherds, being as delicate as feathers, Rey had prostate problems and perianal fistulas that combined prevented him from going to the bathroom. This made him suffer on every walk, rapidly losing his appetite and weight, and losing a lot of blood. So the doctors, with great professionalism, immediately gave us a treatment that within a month had him fixed. We changed his diet, preferring hypoallergenic foods like pork and adding lots of vegetables and supplements, and now he seems like a puppy who is always hungry and wants to play despite being almost nine years old and getting older. But the thing that struck me most, besides the professionalism, is the empathy and love for this work of the doctors who are following him, and I could never thank them enough. 💜

I was recommended this veterinary clinic for my kitten, Louis, and I've always been very happy with it.
They treated him with such care and precision from the very first moment.
They are always attentive, gentle, and ready to explain everything calmly. It's nice to feel welcomed and know your kitten is in good hands.

I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a veterinary clinic where professionalism and animal care go hand in hand.

Absolutely ★★★★★!

I can’t speak highly enough about Dr.ssa Francesca Di Ciommo and her entire team at MyVet Milano. It has taken me more days than I would have liked to write this because I wanted to clearly articulate how important they became to me and my dog during our 3-month stay in Milan. Prior to our departure from the US, I emailed MyVet for help arranging for his EU passport and a health certificate for when we move on to Albania. I received a quick response before we left and had an appointment shortly after our arrival. She gave clear instructions and explanation of how things work and even made the appointment for me at the administrative office I had to go to for his physical passport. Unfortunately, my dog became gravely ill about 7 weeks after our arrival. She brought him in the next morning to start tests, coordinated a same-day surgery when it was discovered he would need one, and coordinated all the specialists for his post-surgery care and oncologic needs. She and her team gave my dog — who is more like my child — rapid, compassionate, thorough, and excellent care. Most importantly, my dog, Fritz, LOVED going there to see his new friends. We were at the clinic a lot because of his illness, and they are the only clinic that he literally dragged me to every time we got off the metro. He was always so excited to see them, which really touched and was important to me because I didn’t want his final weeks being miserable for him. He hated going to clinics in the US, but with Dr.ssa Francesca, Simone, Beatrice, and Martina, he loved it. I think that matters more and is more important than my own compliments. For my part, being in a transient status in Milan, I can never thank them enough for being by my side and not feeling alone through such a painful experience with Fritz and get solace from how much he enjoyed seeing them, even under such terrible circumstances. I will remember all of them very tenderly as important and beloved parts of Fritz’s life. Grazie mille per tutto ❤️

I brought my cat to this clinic yesterday. The examination was performed by Dr. Soresina, who was very kind, empathetic, and professional. The day after starting the treatment she prescribed, I had to contact the clinic again because my cat still wasn't eating and was exhibiting abnormal behavior. Over the phone, Mr. De Michele immediately ruled out the possibility of me receiving feedback or even having another conversation with the doctor the day after the visit, after spending €500. He began urgently pushing for an appointment (for a fee) so I could bring my cat back to the clinic, also offering a same-day dermatological examination (a specialty my cat absolutely doesn't need!!!). It goes without saying that anyone who cares about animal health would do anything to avoid the stress of another transport and clinic visit. However, it's unacceptable that I wasn't given the opportunity for a follow-up the next day through any communication channel with my veterinarian!

To make matters worse, I was contacted again by another person who, without speaking to the vet who had examined the cat and probably without even reading the test results, gave me a definitive diagnosis of severe kidney failure, requiring the cat to be hospitalized and re-examined urgently. This alarmed me in every way possible, urging me to bring the cat in as soon as possible. Finally, I was called by the doctor who had treated him the day before, who, poor thing, tried to patch things up, while the clinic insistently contacted me via WhatsApp, asking me to confirm the appointment.

Result: obviously, I chose to request not one, but two more consultations. Both vets (who were serious!!!) immediately ruled out kidney failure and also reassured me that the cat didn't require hospitalization for the time being.

For them, animals and owners are nothing more than money-making machines, and it's horrible that people's emotions are exploited to get more!

What can I say other than a huge THANK YOU to Dr. Francesca di Ciommo, who literally saved my puppy's ears!!
My puppy (Ottavia), a young Setter-Breton, had always suffered from recurrent ear infections (like many hunting dogs), which we had never been able to completely eliminate with previous vets. The situation worsened in early 2025. Her left ear was destroyed, filled with debris, her eardrum so perforated it was nonexistent, and her tympanic bulla filled with necrotic material. I took Otti to a well-known vet in Milan, who, after a couple of attempted treatments, told me that the only solution was TECALBO, meaning the complete removal of the ear. I didn't resign myself to this hasty diagnosis, which I thought was too absurd for a 3-year-old dog, and I was right!
Thanks to a friend's recommendation, I found Dr. Di Ciommo, who, with kindness, perseverance, empathy, and a wealth of experience, found the right combination of treatments. She literally turned it all around, and today, after three months, we can finally say that my ears ARE HEALED!
I'll conclude by adding that Dr. Di Ciommo, in addition to being always available (even by phone), is also very honest. She always asked me for confirmation before proceeding with any tests she deemed necessary, explaining transparently which were essential for the specific issue and which were additional, always leaving me the option to choose. Whenever possible, she has always accommodated me, even financially.
Dr. Di Ciommo is a truly competent dermatologist and a comprehensive and modern veterinarian, who truly loves her work and establishes an honest relationship with her furry patients and their families. She also has the humility to refer her patients if further specialized investigations outside her area of ​​expertise are needed. In short, for us, it's become an essential point of reference! THANK YOU to Francesca and her entire team for supporting us through our challenges and for continuing to do so!
Thank you!

We went in for vaccinations and a checkup. While talking to the doctor, we mentioned that he'd had some diarrhea recently, but it was almost resolved. At that point, the doctor changed: she started making us anxious, making us undergo a whole series of tests (perhaps too many), and giving us various medications. Finally, she prescribed the treatment and gave us a bill. Well, from a routine visit with periodic vaccinations, we ended up spending almost €1,000. We're now much more careful and disillusioned with vets in general.

After reading reviews and searching for a local clinic, we chose this doctor for our Rhodesian puppy. After more than a year, we can confidently say we're more than satisfied. In addition to her excellent general skills, she's also well-versed in treating specific breed-specific ailments. In our case, she treated vasculitis with a specially designed laser machine, significantly speeding up the recovery process (the laser also helped reduce breast swelling caused by a false pregnancy). Furthermore, the clinic is always available and responds promptly to messages and questions, which is very convenient.
The staff is incredibly kind and makes both our furry friends and us, the owners, feel at ease. They're always available for any questions, concerns, or emergencies. I highly recommend 💜MYVET💜 …

Dr. Francesca brought our little Yorkshire terrier back to life after a serious crisis and finally diagnosed the underlying problem that previous vets had missed. We are grateful for her timely intervention and care!

I couldn't have chosen a better place!

They performed a safe, fast, and competent procedure to remove a foreign body from my dog's stomach. The doctors were excellent, both in their diagnosis and in the post-operative care. Extremely kind and caring, I would recommend them to anyone, even for delicate surgeries and therapies.
